description: Get US Treasury yield curve data (1m through 30y) for a given year. No API key required.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

limit.description: Maximum rows per page; omitted = curated default (25)

year.description: Year to fetch yield curve data for (default: current year)

name: get_treasury_yields
title: Treasury Yield Curve
